---
title: "عصمتِ کُل دربار میں آئیں اور قیامت کیا ہو گی"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Noha"

aliases: []
published: false
---

Ismat e kul darbar may aayain aur qayamt kia ho gi
Binte Nabi gayi jhutlae aur qayamat kia ho gi

1
Jis dar pe tazeem ki khaatir pak Muhammad jhuktay thay
Us dar ko hi aag lagyain aur qayamat kia ho gi

2
Deta hay Salman zamanat khaak pe baith rahi Zahra
Phir bhi Zehra baith na payain aur qayamat kia ho gi

3
Ho nahi sakta woh razi allah dil jo dukhaye Zahra ka
Pak Nabi ki hadees bhulayain aur qayamat kia ho gi

4
Ik darbar ne loota hay Zehra tat-heer ki waris ko
Phir darbar may Zehra jayain aur qayamat ki ho ga

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/ismat-e-kul-darbar-mein-aayen-aur-qayamat-kya-hogi.md')
_, metadata, body = p.read_text().split('---', 2)
roman = metadata.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1]
for edition, digits in [(roman, '1234'), (body, '۱۲۳۴')]:
    blocks = [block.splitlines() for block in '\\n'.join(line.strip() for line in edition.splitlines()).strip().split('\\n\\n')]
    assert list(map(len, blocks)) == [2, 3, 3, 3, 3]
    assert ''.join(block[0] for block in blocks[1:]) == digits
assert '\\u200c' not in body
print('Both editions have two opening verses and four two-verse stanzas.')
PY"
